legal.privacyIntro: KoraLink is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our football match booking platform.
legal.privacyDataCollectionDesc: We collect your phone number, name, profile information, and match participation data. Location data is used to show nearby matches and venues.
legal.privacyDataUseDesc: Your information is used to facilitate match bookings, process payments, enable player communication, and improve our services.
legal.privacyDataSharingDesc: We do not sell your personal data. Match details (name, avatar) are visible to other players in matches you join. Payment processing is handled by authorized payment providers.
legal.termsIntro: By using KoraLink, you agree to these terms. KoraLink provides a platform for booking football matches and connecting players.
legal.termsAccountsDesc: You are responsible for maintaining the accuracy of your profile information and for activities conducted through your account.
legal.termsMatchesDesc: Match hosts are responsible for venue bookings. Players agree to attend matches they join. No-shows may affect your karma score and eligibility for Player of the Match voting.
legal.termsPaymentsDesc: Wallet top-ups are non-refundable. Match fees are deducted from your wallet balance upon joining. Refunds for cancelled matches are credited back to your wallet.
